name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the supacharge docker product (composes an app named rcore)

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.

modules.name: lms
modules._comment: Supacharge's home SDK (LMS domain: lessons, schedule, partner links).

modules.name: replay
modules._comment: Supacharge's session-replay SDK (Replay Session schedule + decision #8 release-asset pipeline: fetch/cache/serve, warm + evict). Composed beside lms, which its serving gates resolve into.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9, mirroring the flutter templates' telemetry_sdk entries). Empty-manifest seam owner: installs nothing; base_sdk's kernel carries the TelemetryClient.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570 (git blob 7020b16a, 1074 bytes); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The base SDK's nextjs half (core#160): the platform kernel — app/services/base (platform gateway, tenant hosts, session, telemetry), the base admin content/settings/system actions and pages, the manager shell, the shared app sidebar, nav-user/team-switcher, date-range-picker and use-mobile. Composed here because telemetry_sdk 'requires' app/services/base/platform-gateway.ts, which only this half installs: without it the supacharge-web composed build cannot resolve @/app/services/base/platform-gateway. Its own 'requires' names host-owned files (lib/utils.ts, the components/ui primitives, components/custom/branding.tsx, app/config/*, app/lib/*) plus merchants_sdk's shop action and merchant-nav and auth_sdk's app/lib/session.ts — warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install; the supacharge-web shell provides the host-owned half.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of auth/nextjs/install.py at Users@db78a963 (git blob 0ab330a0, 1098 bytes; same digest rokctapp.json pins); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The auth SDK's nextjs half (Users#83/#84): the app/(auth) route group (credentials login/register/forgot-password + the [...nextauth] handler), the NextAuth-backed app/lib/session.ts seam, paas-login/auth-form/submit-button components, db/ + lib/drizzle schema, drizzle.config.ts and middleware.ts. Listed after base_sdk (requires its platform-gateway service). Composed here because base_sdk's landing links its CTAs to /login and /register (LANDING_CONFIG.loginUrl/signupUrl), which 404 without this SDK, and because base_sdk's session reader (app/services/base/session.ts) goes through app/lib/session.ts, which only this half implements: without it the shell's session seam resolves to null and the composed /admin and /manager pages are ungated. Its own 'requires' names host-owned files (app/config/compose.ts, constants.ts, platform.ts, app/lib/i18n, components/custom/branding/header/icons, components/ui primitives) - warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install; the supacharge-web shell provides the host-owned half.

sdks.name: lms_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of lms/nextjs/install.py at agent@a0544677 (git blob 7de40f08, 1097 bytes; the agent#242 head de0df52b does not touch install.py, so the digest is the same there); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The lms SDK's nextjs half (agent#242, lms_sdk 1.2.0): Supacharge's home SDK, the Next.js counterpart of core/utils/flutter/composer/supacharge.json flagging lms_sdk home_sdk: true. Owns the app/handson/all/lms page/action/service trees, the app/page.tsx that serves `/` (anonymous visitors redirect to /landing, signed-in users to the lms home; reads the session through base_sdk's kernel seam), components/custom/landing/lms-landing-config.ts and the landing sections (floating nav, sessions, subjects, tutors, features, partners, pricing, faq, testimonials, footer) it registers into base_sdk's components/custom/landing/page-sections.ts at the // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start marker, plus its Learning / My Profile / My Batches entries at the sidebar's // @rokct-sdk-nav-start marker. Listed after auth_sdk because the composer installs in array order and its 'requires' names files the two halves above install: base_sdk's app/services/base/session.ts, app/actions/base/landing.ts, landing-config.ts and page-sections.ts (the markers its integrations anchor to) and auth_sdk's app/(auth)/actions.ts. Its own 'requires' also names host-owned files (app/lib/roles.ts, app/lib/format.ts, app/services/common/base.ts, components/custom/branding.tsx, the components/ui primitives, lib/utils.ts) - warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install; the supacharge-web shell provides the host-owned half.
